domain: open axis: operating-efficiency-improvement family (year-over-year change in asset turnover) on the death-inclusive cohort, built ENTIRELY from the hash-pinned multi-vintage PIT fundamentals panel (V9 sha256 67591464ee49acc159886143a379bda5890b1df602818b600d7938df92af1447) and the staged death-inclusive EODHD price store. No new vendor leg, no second EODHD field family (none has P2 coverage this cycle). The price leg is used only for eligibility, band assignment, fills, exits and benchmark context; no price-, volume- or return-derived observable enters any exposure; no share-count field enters any exposure (V11 A6 ancestry exclusion); no revision direction, no timing-lag and no amendment-chain observable is cited as signal. The exposure's change is ACROSS SUCCESSIVE FISCAL PERIODS of the same fields, never across revisions of one period - the revision axis is never touched.
title: Operating-efficiency improvements are slow information: long year-over-year asset-turnover improvers, short deteriorators, market-neutral, on the death-inclusive cohort

named_literature: Soliman (2008), 'The Use of DuPont Analysis by Market Participants', The Accounting Review 83(3) - the canonical result: firms with positive year-over-year changes in asset turnover (sales/assets) earn significant positive abnormal returns, because the efficiency change predicts future profitability and the market impounds it only partially, with the effect concentrated in low-attention stocks

Nissim & Penman (2001), 'Ratio Analysis and Equity Valuation: From Research to Practice', Review of Accounting Studies 6 - the sustainable-growth decomposition that establishes asset turnover as one of the two distinct drivers of residual-income growth

Fairfield & Yohn (2001), 'Using Asset Turnover and Profit Margin to Forecast Changes in Profitability', Review of Accounting Studies 6 - asset-turnover change and margin change carry DISTINCT information about next-period profitability change; the turnover face is a separately informative signal, not a margin proxy

Abarbanell & Bushee (1998), 'Fundamental Analysis, Future Earnings, and Security Values', Journal of Accounting Research 36 - fundamental signals drawn from operating ratios predict future earnings and returns
Lev & Thiagarajan (1993), 'Fundamental Information Analysis', Journal of Accounting Research 31 - the market under-reacts to low-salience operating fundamentals, the under-impounding channel

Hirshleifer & Teoh (2003), 'Limited Attention, Information Disclosure, and Financial Reporting', Journal of Accounting and Economics 36 - why an operating ratio nobody headlines is priced slowly, and why the under-reaction concentrates where analyst and media attention is thinnest - the dead-tail cohort this program owns
mechanism_lineage.economic_story: Asset turnover - revenue per dollar of assets - is the efficiency face of the DuPont decomposition. When it improves year-over-year, the firm is extracting more revenue from the resources it already controls: either genuinely improving operations or, per the Fairfield-Yohn separation, releasing information about next-period profitability that margin changes do not carry. Soliman (2008) shows the market treats this as noise: the ratio is never headlined, it moves slowly, and the under-reaction persists for quarters - precisely the horizon slow-moving capital needs (Duffie 2010) and precisely where attention-constrained pricing fails hardest (Hirshleifer-Teoh 2003). In a death-inclusive cohort the mechanism has teeth at the tail: a dying name that improvers its revenue velocity is fighting its way off the distress path, and a deteriorator is sliding down it; institutional demand cannot reach either (no benchmark product contains 1,647 of these names), so the repricing is left to the slowest capital in the market.

falsifiable_prediction: The market-neutral asset-turnover-change book (gross 1.0, net approximately 0, event-staggered decisions at V12-S3 structure-complete instants, 21-session holds, 3 folds) has positive expectancy AFTER base band costs, position PF >= 1.10, >= 2 of 3 folds positive expectancy, max fold MDD <= 15%, risk-matched SPY-excess expectancy > 0 overall and in >= 2 folds, and the permutation control's expectancy is NOT same-sign >= 0.5x the anchor's (and never outruns a negative anchor). The family is FALSIFIED if any of: anchor expectancy <= 0 after base costs; the control reproduces the anchor per the frozen falsification rule (same-sign >= 0.5x -> DEAD); pooled novelty |rho| > 0.20 vs any of the THIRTEEN veto entries at D2, measured pre-selection on conditioning exposures; self-subsumption rho > 0.98 between anchor and control exposures (design failure, kills pre-score); drop-one survival fails; the 2x stress rerun is nonpositive; reproduction is not ALL_MATCH. REJECT is a successful outcome; no gate is weakened to admit a thin margin (P-2 margins recorded, never traded away).

clock.conditioner_definition: for entity i at decision instant tau: ATO_t_i(tau) = REV_last_i(tau) / ASSETS_last_i(tau) from the latest evidenced period vintage, and ATO_prev_i(tau) = REV_prev_i / ASSETS_prev_i from the immediately preceding eff-period group of the same field streams; exposure X_i(tau) = ATO_t_i(tau) - ATO_prev_i(tau) (the year-over-year asset-turnover change). All four inputs from evidenced vintages stamped strictly before decision-session start-of-day, all within the 800-day bound. The change is ACROSS FISCAL PERIODS, never across revisions of one period. No price, volume, share-count, revision, timing or chain input enters X.

Positions hold 21 sessions (the carried V8-V11 window) or until forced exit; books aggregate across entities per session; force-flat with cost at every fold boundary. warmup_rationale: 3 spans = 63 sessions of price history for the ADV63 band assignment and the >= 63-bar eligibility floor; the exposure itself needs no expanding history beyond its two consecutive evidenced vintage pairs, so no additional abstention is declared; any decision may abstain fail-closed if the cohort scoreable floor (30) or a leg floor (5) is unmet.
entry_exit_fills: band-resolved house fills: signals computed from PIT stamps strictly before the decision session and bars through session t-1 (eligibility, ADV63 band); orders filled at the NEXT session, close-to-close, no same-session fill (STRICT_NEXT_BAR); fill-check: a name without a bar at the fill session simply does not fill (its order does not exist; legs are NOT renormalized - realized gross is reported); holding one 21-session span; force-flat with cost at fold boundaries; L-I3 fail-closed band resolution throughout (research/assets/stocks/kernel_band_cost_v9.py); dead-name exit at last recorded close per universe.dead_name_semantics, charged per resolve_exit_band_bps (C-rate ceiling when the exit band is unrateable).

book_form.form: daily market-neutral long/short on plain continuous MAD-scaled weights (NOT sector-residual - declared structural difference from SFV12-A6-H1, and the reason is mechanism content: turnover dispersion is dominated by WITHIN-industry business-model variation per Soliman (2008), and a plain net-neutral book leaves the book's beta to the SPY-excess gate rather than engineering it away; the frozen exposure, ETF-share and SPY-excess gates apply unchanged to this book form per the §2.1 carried provision).
book_form.frozen_justification: the two proposals must be materially distinct constructions (wave diversity binding), and the honest test of this mechanism is whether the turnover-change signal survives residual sector tilts under the SPY-excess crucible; declared ex-ante, with the fold-MDD and SPY-excess gates as the declared binding defense. No ETF legs exist in any arm.
book_form.implementation: leg weights w_i proportional to the cross-sectionally demeaned exposure scaled by 1.4826 * MAD (the frozen min_hist_frozen scale convention); long positive (improvers), short negative (deteriorators), normalized to gross 1.0 (0.5 per leg); abstain if either leg < 5 names or the cohort scoreable floor < 30 valid exposures is unmet.
book_form.dead_leg_honesty: exit-at-last-close on DEAD_PRICE_CONFIRMED legs; no post-death window is booked in any arm (the post-death reorg/survival semantics of NOT_DEAD_PRICE_SURVIVAL names never touch this family - those names are excluded at the universe level).

costs.model: p3_v12_invariants_freeze.json carried payload, verbatim: 'band model A/B/C 10/15/25 bps per side base, stress x2 applied to booked PnL; costs linear in fills; charged exactly once per fill'. Kernel: BAND_BPS = {"A": 10.0, "B": 15.0, "C": 25.0}; band_of(ADV63): >= 50,000,000 A, >= 10,000,000 B, >= 2,000,000 C, else UNTRADABLE; entries never use the UNTRADABLE path.
costs.application: costs linear in fills (|dw| x band bps x multiplier / 10,000), charged exactly once per fill per side, applied to BOOKED PnL; no sidecar, no accrual-by-stamp.
costs.resolution: L-I3 fail-closed: a traded name without a computed band raises BandResolutionError; the silent 10 bps fallback is forbidden; terminal/exit fills of names whose band has become UNTRADABLE or missing are charged the C-rate ceiling (25 bps base / 50 stress) per resolve_exit_band_bps - a computed conservative resolution, never a default.
costs.stress: stress tier = x2 multiplier on booked PnL (20/30/50 bps); gate: stress PnL > 0 and stress PF >= 1.0.

arms.spec: At each decision instant: plain market-neutral continuous weights on X = ATO_t - ATO_prev (long improvers, short deteriorators; equal gross 0.5/0.5; MAD-scaled per frozen convention; no sector, price, share-count or chain input in X). Abstains fail-closed on the frozen floors.

Long-only improvers book: identical machinery, eligibility, clock and floors, long leg only (X > 0), gross 1.0, equal MAD-scaled weights. Materially different leg construction, declared mechanism content: attention limits bind hardest on the short side of micro-caps (borrow constraints, recall risk), so the tradable face of the under-reaction is the long-improver side; a long-only result with the same sign supports the mechanism, while an anchor that works ONLY through the short-deteriorator leg is declared elevated-risk evidence (short-side mechanics contamination at the distressed tail) and downweights the family regardless of the anchor's profitability. This arm also sidesteps the distressed-tail short book entirely, which is why it is the neighbour.

Deterministic within-decision permutation placebo (matched-null): at each scored decision, the anchor's exposure VALUES are permuted across that decision's eligible names using a frozen deterministic hash order (sha256 of the string cycle|{hypothesis_id}|{cik}|{decision_index}, hex-sorted - no RNG library, byte-reproducible; permutation across the full eligible set, distinct from H1's within-sector variant). The permutation preserves the exact cross-sectional distribution of exposures, the exact eligibility set, and all fill/cost/dead-leg machinery, while destroying the name-to-improvement link. RUNNABILITY by construction: it abstains exactly where the anchor abstains and can never abort on data semantics (forex V3 lesson); every input is a PIT panel stamp and a staged price bar. Refutation semantics: if the permuted book reproduces the anchor (>= 0.5x same-sign expectancy, or outrunning the anchor including the negative-anchor case), the priced object was size, sector composition or cohort structure rather than the efficiency improvement, and the family dies per the frozen falsification-by-control rule. This control knowingly walks into the cluster's gunsight; that is its purpose.

exposure_definition: Per entity i at decision instant tau, for the D2 rank-correlation screen against each of the THIRTEEN veto entries on the same decision x entity cohort: EXPOSURE_i(tau) = (REV_last_i/ASSETS_last_i) - (REV_prev_i/ASSETS_prev_i), both period pairs from evidenced vintages stamped strictly before tau and inside the 800-day bound, all values strictly positive; the name is unscored at tau if any input is missing, non-positive, or stale (abstain, counted). The change is computed across consecutive EFF periods of the same field stream, never across revisions of one period (no revision-over-revision difference is ever formed - that is the vetoed V10 geometry and this family does not touch it). Primary revenue field per entity = the priority-ordered revenue field with the most period groups in the panel (ties broken by priority order us-gaap:Revenues > us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax); assets us-gaap:Assets; BOTH periods of a pair use the SAME field (no cross-field synthesis - cross-field period alignment is not evidenced). Ranking direction for D2: DESCENDING exposure (largest improvement = rank 1). Inputs are exactly the evidenced panel stamps and values plus each stamp's own availability evidence; no price, volume, share-price, share-count, sector, revision, timing-lag, chain, COGS or cash-flow-statement field enters the exposure. D2 computes pooled Spearman rho of this exposure vs each veto-entry exposure; pooled |rho| <= 0.20 required, measured pre-selection; hedged relabellings die.

own_orthogonality_argument_per_veto_entr.5_Goodwill_bloat: the DECLARED BINDING RISK of this family, named first: the exposure's denominator contains period-over-period assets, so asset growth enters mechanically with a negative sign (growers' turnover falls). d2_predeclarations.b_anchor_vs_control_identifiability: pooled Spearman rho(anchor exposure vector, control exposure vector) measured BEFORE selection from PIT panel inputs only (the permutation is exposure-space arithmetic; no outcome file exists or is needed). The within-decision permutation decorrelates name assignment, so the measured rho is expected near 0; the pre-declared kill is SELF-SUBSUMPTION: pooled rho > 0.98 means the control degenerated into the anchor (the sham was not executed as declared) and kills the family PRE-SCORE as a DESIGN FAILURE, not a pass. The control can refute the mechanism because it deletes exactly the name-to-improvement association while holding eligibility, weights machinery, fills and costs fixed (P-3: its verdict binds under the data semantics it was computed with and recomputes under any semantics change).

incremental_alpha_test: per the frozen factor_and_benchmark contract carried from V8/V9/V10: arm return minus risk-matched SPY context (SPY scaled ex ante by the arm's frozen gross rule), per fold and overall; gate: overall SPY-excess expectancy > 0 and >= 2 of 3 folds positive; secondary equal-weight 11-SPDR sector-ETF factor reported per fold (reported, not gated - the gate this book's residual sector tilts face is the SPY-excess gate, declared in book_form). ETF-share gate <= 0.50 where ETF legs exist: NOT_APPLICABLE ex-ante (declared in stage_a_gate_table); SPY-excess positivity gates as stated. The book is approximately net-neutral by construction, so the alpha gate binds on mechanism absence, not beta dressing - with the residual-tilt admission honest and gated.
turnover_and_sample_floor: >= 30 scored decisions overall and >= 5 per fold (binding minimum; expected counts from the S3 census scale are far above the floor - A9 verifies from the frozen calendar, structure only). Per-span one-way turnover from the 21-session holding is structurally ~1x gross per span plus exits; every fill is charged exactly once per the cost contract; dead-leg exits add fills at death and are charged at the C-ceiling resolution. If floors abstain the family under count, the verdict is INFEASIBLE (declared in stage_a_gate_table), never a silently reduced book.
drop_one_design: (1) drop-one-symbol: rerun excluding the max-contribution name; survival iff after-drop expectancy > 0. (2) drop-one-fold: expectancy recomputed with each fold removed; survival iff min over folds > 0. (3) drop-one-field: rerun with each priority revenue tag excluded in turn as primary (field-priority sensitivity of the coverage rule, not a parameter search - the declared reruns only). All reruns inherit identical eligibility, bands, fills, costs, book form and dead-name semantics.
